summary: At segment 0 step 20, the five-turn levitation timeout should print "You float slightly lower." before decrementing. JavaScript skips timeout.c:levitation_dialogue(), leaving the message row blank while RNG and cursor match. Port the whole dialogue function and wire nh_timeout(), including ordinary versus urgent warnings, extrinsic and terrain suppression, occupation stopping, and planning/live execution.

source.branch: nh_timeout() calls the dialogue whenever HLevitation & TIMEOUT is nonzero, before property decrements. levitation_dialogue computes i=((timeout-1)/2), returns for any ELevitation, and returns when the hero terrain is inaccessible and is neither pool nor lava. Only odd timeout values with i in 1..2 print: timeout 5 uses ordinary pline1("You float slightly lower."); timeout 3 uses urgent_pline("You wobble unsteadily %s the %s."). The latter says "over" plus surface() above pool/lava outside the Plane of Water, otherwise "in" and "air". Each emitted warning then calls stop_occupation(). Timeout 1 leaves the final descent message to float_down().
callers: C timeout.c:nh_timeout():633-634 tests HLevitation & TIMEOUT and calls levitation_dialogue(), between sickness_dialogue and phaze_dialogue, before the common property decrement loop at 670-672. At examined commit 9758aabc, js/timeout.js:nh_timeout():1545-1546 instead records note_unported("timeout.c levitation_dialogue") on the live path and does nothing for that call during planning.

C allmain.c:moveloop_core():273 calls nh_timeout() during each elapsed game turn before run_regions(). JS js/allmain.js:finishElapsedTurn() calls nh_timeout() at 906, with planning-safe message callbacks, and consults timeout.js:nh_timeout_requires_live_state() at 904 before that call. The assigned final dot command reaches this production turn path with levitation timeout 5.
dependencies: Use HLevitation as u.uprops[LEVITATION].intrinsic masked with TIMEOUT, and ELevitation as the raw extrinsic field. Preserve the C guards rather than substituting the combined Levitation predicate or changing blocked-property semantics.

ACCESSIBLE is available from const.js; dbridge.js:is_pool_or_lava() implements the consumed terrain predicate, including water/lava beneath raised drawbridges. Is_waterlevel is already available to timeout.js. dungeon.js:surface() implements the danger-branch noun; preserve any display-RNG behavior from its hallucinated liquid name when used on a planning clone.

ttyPline and ttyUrgentPline supply different source message operations. Pass ordinary and urgent callbacks through the existing timeout environment, await each warning before stop_occupation(), and retain silent callbacks for planning.

allmain.js:stop_occupation() is already imported by timeout.js. Dialogue warnings can cancel an active occupation, so production wiring must account for this state effect in nh_timeout_requires_live_state() and the elapsed-turn planning/live handoff; its present LEVITATION check covers only timeout==1, not the warnings at 5 and 3.

The existing common timeout decrement and LEVITATION expiry arm should remain in C order: dialogue first, decrement later, float_down(I_SPECIAL|TIMEOUT,0) at actual expiry. This recording establishes the five-turn warning, not float_down runtime coverage.
